blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We report that allocating compute to synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training in our compute-matched experiments. This holds across four PPT curricula (k-Dyck, neural cellular automata (NCA), declarative reference corpora, and code) and three training regimes: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and a high token-to-parameter-ratio regime (881M parameters trained on 50B tokens). When natural language is scarce, repeated epochs over a 100M-token corpus beat every synthetic curriculum on natural-language validation loss, with no consistent downstream accuracy advantage from PPT. We find that PPT gains reported in prior work are sensitive to the weight initialization scheme. In an NCA reproduction, we recover a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT under the original initialization scheme. An alternative scheme improves both methods, but the no-PPT baseline more, closing the gap between them. However, when PPT receives additional compute rather than a share of the natural-language budget, gains persist at small natural-language budgets even with improved initialization, but disappear by 1B tokens. Finally, models forget what they learn during PPT in subsequent natural-language training; interleaving the same data throughout training prevents forgetting, but does not significantly improve natural-language performance. Our results suggest limited benefits of synthetic pre-pretraining as a distinct training stage and motivate rethinking how such data are used in language model training.
blocks.zh: 我们报告说,分配计算到合成预训(PPT)中,在我们计算匹配的实验中,绝对不会超过纯自然语言训练. 这涉及四个PPT课程(k-Dyck,神经细胞自发性(NCA),声明性参考物和代码)和三个培训制度:数据约束,数据不约束,以及一个高标码到参数比例制度(581M参数在50B符上培训). 当自然语言稀缺时,100M-token活体上反复出现的时代会用自然语言验证损失来打败每一个合成课程,而PPT在下游没有一致的准确性优势. 我们发现,先前工作中报告的PPT增益对权重初始化计划很敏感. 在一次NCAA复制中,我们根据最初的初始化计划从PPT中恢复了5.4%的复杂度改善. 一种替代方案改进了这两种方法,但增加了不使用PPT的基线,缩小了两者之间的差距。 然而,当PPT收到额外的计算而不是自然语言预算的份额时,即使初始化改善,在小型自然语言预算上仍会持续得到收益,但被1B符所消失. 最后,模型在之后的自然语言培训中忘记了在PPT期间学到的东西;在整个培训中将同样的数据相互连接,防止了遗忘,但并没有显著地提高自然语言的性能. 我们的结果表明,合成预科培训作为一个独特的培训阶段的效益有限,并激励人们重新考虑这些数据如何用于语言模式培训。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Rich computational structure can be learned from naturally occurring text. The benefits of scaling training on such tokens have yet to hit a ceiling, though increasingly large amounts of data are required for further improvements in performance ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) . By contrast, humans acquire language from far less linguistic experience ( Warstadt et al., 2023 ) , and their reasoning abilities are largely dissociable from linguistic proficiency ( Fedorenko et al., 2024 ) . This contrast has motivated recent work to ask whether useful linguistic and computational priors can instead be acquired from synthetic data. Beyond making language learning more sample-efficient, synthetic distributions supply effectively unlimited training data once high-quality natural language becomes scarce.
blocks.zh: 丰富的计算结构可以从自然出现的文本中学习. 扩大此类标志的培训的效益尚未达到上限,尽管进一步提高业绩需要越来越多的数据(Kaplan等,2020年)。 相形之下,人类从语言经验相去甚远(Warstadt等,2023年)获得语言,他们的推理能力基本上与语言能力脱节(Fedorenko等,2024年). 这一对比促使最近的工作询问是否可以从合成数据中获取有用的语言和计算前科。 除了使语言学习更具样本效率外,一旦高质量的自然语言变得稀缺,合成分集会有效提供无限的培训数据.

blocks.en: This idea is operationalized in prior work through pre-pretraining (PPT): a training phase on synthetic data that precedes conventional pretraining (PT) and is intended to produce an initialization with useful priors for learning language. Different synthetic distributions target different computational priors: k k -Dyck encourages hierarchical dependency tracking ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , neural cellular automata (NCA) expose models to latent transition rules and long-range dependencies ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , and procedural tasks train operations such as copying, sorting, and retrieval ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . These approaches have reported gains in language modeling and context recall, including up to 8.6% lower perplexity for NCA, both when PPT is given additional compute on top of a fixed natural-language budget and when PPT and natural-language training share a fixed total compute budget.
blocks.zh: 这一想法通过预训(PPT):在常规预训(PT)之前的合成数据培训阶段,在前期工作中得到应用,旨在产生一个带有学习语言的有用前科的初始化. 不同的合成分布针对不同的计算前期: kk-Dyck鼓励分级依赖跟踪(Hu等,2025年),神经细胞自体(NCA)使模型暴露出潜在的过渡规则和远程依赖(Lee等,2026年),以及复制,分拣,检索等程序任务列车操作(Jiang等,2026年). 这些方法报告在语言建模和背景回顾方面有所改进,包括NCAA的低迷度高达8.6%,无论是在PPT在固定自然语言预算之外额外计算时,还是在PPT和自然语言培训共用固定的总计算预算时。

blocks.en: Although prior work has demonstrated gains from synthetic PPT, how robust these gains are across other training configurations and regimes remains unclear. We therefore revisit synthetic PPT across a range of training regimes. We study three synthetic distributions ( k k -Dyck, NCA, and declarative reference corpora (DeclRef)), alongside code, which prior work has found can improve downstream reasoning beyond coding tasks ( Aryabumi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 虽然以往的工作表明合成PPT有所收效,但其他培训组合和机制的这些收效如何强劲仍不清楚。 因此,我们通过一系列培训制度重新审视合成PPT。 我们研究了三种合成分布(kk-Dyck、NCAA和声明性参考物corpora(Decl Ref)),同时研究了以前发现的编码,除了编码任务之外,还可以改进下游推理(Aryabumi等,2025年)。

blocks.en: We begin by asking whether synthetic PPT can provide useful inductive biases when it is not competing with natural-language training for compute. In this additive-compute setting, where PPT is added on top of a fixed natural-language budget, we first reproduce a prior NCA result as a positive control before testing the setting more broadly. We then ask whether PPT is worth its compute when it competes directly with natural-language training for a fixed FLOP budget. We evaluate this compute-matched condition across three regimes: a data-constrained setting, where the alternative is repeated training on the same 100M natural-language tokens; a data-unconstrained setting, which tests whether any PPT recipe remains competitive as training compute scales; and a high token-to-parameter ratio setting, which probes whether PPT becomes useful far beyond the Chinchilla-optimal frontier. Our findings are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们首先询问,如果合成的PPT不与自然语言的计算培训相竞争,它能否提供有益的诱导偏差。 在这种添加剂计算设置中,在固定自然语言预算之上添加PPT,我们首先复制先前NCAA结果作为正控结果,然后更广泛地测试设置. 然后我们问PPT在直接与固定的FLOP预算的自然语言培训竞争时是否值得它的计算. 我们通过三种制度来评估这一计算匹配的条件:一个数据受限制的设置,即对同一个100M自然语言符号进行重复培训;一个数据受限制的设置,即测试任何PPT配方在培训计算尺度上是否仍然具有竞争力;以及一个高的符号对参数比例设置,即探究PPT是否在远远超出Chinchilla-优化边界之外发挥作用。 我们的调查结果如下:

blocks.en: 1. Gains from PPT are sensitive to the baseline initialization scheme. We reproduce a previously reported NCA result under its original setup, recovering a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT. However, changing the token embedding initialization from 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathcal{N}(0,1) to 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.02 ) \mathcal{N}(0,0.02) closes the gap between NCA and the no-PPT baseline. 2. Additive compute: PPT can help at small natural-language budgets. When each method is tuned over initialization schemes, k k -Dyck and NCA improve over the best no-PPT baseline at 50M and 100M natural-language tokens (budgets reported to parallel the amount of language humans may learn from, Warstadt et al., 2023 ). However, by 1B tokens the advantage disappears. This suggests synthetic PPT can instill useful inductive biases, but its benefits diminish at larger natural-language budgets. 3. Compute-matched: natural-language training performs as well as or better than PPT across all compute-matched regimes. This includes the strongest scarcity case, where multiple epochs on 100M unique natural-language tokens beat every synthetic curriculum. The same holds on most of our downstream evaluations, both DCLM CORE ( Li et al., 2024 ) and BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) , with exceptions confined to our smallest compute budget (Table 1 ). 4. Uniformly interleaving the same data throughout training instead preserves performance on those distributions, but we do not find significant improvement in natural-language validation loss.

blocks.en: These findings highlight the surprising effectiveness of naturally occurring data as a training signal: even when unique natural-language tokens are scarce, repeated training on them remains more useful than training on the synthetic corpora we test. Importantly, we do not take this to imply that synthetic data cannot help. Instead, our results point to front-loading synthetic data as a poor way to use it, since what is learned during PPT is progressively lost once natural-language training begins. It may instead be better integrated gradually, through interleaving that avoids the abrupt distribution shift between PPT and PT. Our results therefore motivate rethinking the PPT phase, rather than ruling out synthetic data as a training corpus.
blocks.zh: 这些发现凸显出自然产生的数据作为一种培训信号的惊人效果:即使独特的自然语言符号稀缺,重复的关于这些数据的培训仍然比我们测试的合成体培训更有用. 重要的是,我们不认为这意味着合成数据无济于事。 相反,我们的结果表明,前置合成数据是一种不好的使用方法,因为一旦自然语言培训开始,PPT期间学到的东西就逐渐丢失了。 相反,通过相互分离,避免PPT和PT之间突然的分布转移,可以更好地逐步整合。 因此,我们的成果促使人们重新思考PPT阶段,而不是排除将合成数据作为培训工具。

blocks.en: 2 Background & Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Pre-pretraining
blocks.zh: 2.1 预训

blocks.en:
All prior work in synthetic pre-pretraining shares a common hypothesis: training on certain synthetic distributions can instill language-modeling priors that transfer to natural language. Designed to encourage in-context learning, these distributions can be generated procedurally in effectively unlimited quantities.
PPT corpora in prior work can be divided broadly into three categories: formal languages ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ) , algorithmic tasks ( Wu et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and data sampled from randomly initialized neural networks ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . Of these, we focus on k k -Dyck and NCA, for which prior work reports the largest improvements in natural-language perplexity.
blocks.zh:
所有以前在合成预科培训中的工作都有一个共同的假设:关于某些合成分布的培训可以将语言模型前科注入自然语言。 设计鼓励内文学习,这些分配可以程序上生成,实际上数量无限.
前作中的PPT corpora可以大致分为三类: 正式语言(Hu等,2025;Mita等,2026),算法任务(Wu等,2022;Jiang等,2026),以及从随机初始神经网络采集的数据样本(Lee等,2026;Guo等,2026). 其中,我们注重k-k-Dyck和NCA,为此,前期工作报告自然语言通俗性改进最大.

blocks.en: Hu et al. (2025) introduce PPT on k k -Dyck languages, formal languages over a vocabulary of k k bracket types whose grammar requires that every opening bracket is eventually closed. For example, at k = 2 k=2 , with vocabulary { ( , ) , [ , ] }, the string ([()][]) is valid. They find the k k -Shuffle Dyck variant performs best at k = 128 k=128 , and it is this variant we refer to as k k -Dyck throughout the paper. Lee et al. (2026) instead use NCA for PPT. A cellular automaton is a grid of cells, each holding a value from a finite vocabulary—for example, one of ten symbols. The grid evolves over discrete time steps: at each step, every cell takes a new value as a function of the cells in its immediate neighborhood, using a single update rule applied identically to every cell. This can be defined as follows: let x t x_{t} denote the state of the whole grid at time step t t , then an initial state x 0 x_{0} and an update rule f f give x t = f ⁡ ( x t − 1 ) x_{t}=f(x_{t-1}) . An NCA replaces f f with a randomly initialized convolutional neural network.

blocks.en: To construct an NCA PPT corpus, Lee et al. (2026) sample a random initial grid, with each cell assigned a value drawn from the fixed vocabulary, together with a randomly initialized convolutional neural network as the update rule. They then run the simulation forward for a fixed number of time steps. At this point, the resulting rollouts range from low-entropy static grids to more complex, visually interesting ones. Hence, each rollout is further filtered by a proxy-complexity metric, the gzip compression ratio, and only those falling within the highest compression band are kept. Each grid in a retained rollout is then flattened exactly as a 2D image tensor would be, and the flattened grids are concatenated in time step order into a one-dimensional token sequence for training.

blocks.en: The experimental protocol is largely shared across the PPT methods in the literature. The natural-language token budget and training recipe are fixed, and a synthetic data phase is prepended, with the number of PPT tokens varied to optimize the downstream natural-language loss after PT. The usual control replaces the synthetic tokens with an equal number of natural-language tokens, and a gain is reported if PPT reaches a lower downstream loss than this control. Methods are therefore compared at equal total tokens and equal model size.
blocks.zh: 实验协议在文献中主要通过PPT方法共享. 自然语符号预算和培训食谱是固定的,一个合成数据相被预想,PPT符号数量各有不同,以优化PT后下游自然语损失. 通常的控制用等量的自然语言符号来取而代之的合成代币,如果PPT达到比这个控制更低的下游损失,则报告得分. 因此,对方法进行比较时,总值和模型大小相同。

blocks.en:
In their largest-scale experiment, training a 1.6B-parameter model, Lee et al. (2026) report that PPT on 164M NCA tokens improves perplexity by 5.7% compared to the no-PPT baseline.
In Hu et al. (2025) ’s largest experiment, pre-pretraining a 1B-parameter model on k k -Dyck before 1.6B natural-language tokens reduces final cross-entropy loss by around 0.6% ( ∼ 2 % {\sim}2\% in perplexity). Both works additionally report gains on public downstream benchmarks: reasoning benchmarks for NCA like BIG-bench Lite ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , and BLiMP for k k -Dyck ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . We evaluate both fronts in this work, scoring every method on BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) , and on the DCLM CORE suite ( Li et al., 2024 ) , which contains BIG-bench tasks, among them a subset of BIG-bench Lite. A recent study reproduced the k k -Dyck gain ( Hu et al., 2025 ) under the original conditions. However, it found that the gain did not consistently persist across all model sizes, tokenizers, and languages tested ( Riazhskykh et al., 2026 ) . These mixed results motivate our study, and since k k -Dyck has already been reproduced, our own reproduction (Section 4 ) focuses on NCA. Concurrently with our work, Yamaguchi et al. (2026) study PPT on k k -Shuffle Dyck and NCA at larger scales, where they report downstream benchmark gains for PPT methods but do not claim improvements in validation loss. However, like prior work, they also keep the weight-initialization scheme fixed. We find that ablating it significantly improves the natural-language baseline, enough to close its gap with PPT.
blocks.zh:
在最大的实验中,培训了1.6B参数模型,Lee等人(2026年)报告说,与无PPT基线相比,164M NCAA标志上的PPT提高了5.7%。
在Hu等人(2025年)最大的实验中,在1.6B自然语言符号之前在k-Dyck上预先训练出一个1B参数模型,将最终的交叉性损失减少约0.6%(∼ 2% {\ sim}2\% \%). 这两项工作还报告了公共下游基准方面的进展:NCA的推理基准,如BIG-bench Lite(Lee等,2026年)和K-Dyck的BLIMP(Hu等,2025年)。 我们评价了这项工作的两条战线,在BLIMP(Warstadt等,2020年)和DCLMCORE套件(Li等,2024年)上评分了每一个方法,其中包含BIG-bench任务,包括BIG-bench Lite的子集. 最近的一项研究根据原始条件转载了kk-Dyck增益(Hu等,2025年)。 然而,它发现,这一收益并没有在所有模型大小、标注剂和测试语言中持续(Riazhskykh等人,2026年)。 这些好坏参半的结果激励了我们的研究,由于kk-Dyck已经复制,我们自己的复制(第4节)侧重于NCA. 在开展工作的同时,Yamaguchi等人(2026年)对PPT进行关于k k-Shuffle Dyck和NCA的较大尺度的研究,他们报告PPT方法的下游基准收益,但并不要求改进审定损失。 然而,与以前的工作一样,它们也使权重初始化计划固定下来。 我们发现,将其夷为平地可以大大地改善自然语言基线,足以弥补与PPT的差距.

blocks.en: 2.2 Training regimes
blocks.zh: 2.2 培训制度

blocks.en: How a compute budget should be spent depends on which resource is scarce. When natural language is the constraint, additional compute buys only repeated passes over the same tokens. Muennighoff et al. (2023) characterize this setting and find that, for their models and data, up to four epochs of repetition are close to lossless, after which the gains from additional compute rapidly diminish and new data is more useful. The slowrun benchmark ( Vegesna et al., 2026 ) isolates the regime in its extreme form, fixing a 100M-token sample of FineWeb and leaving compute essentially unconstrained. Work in this setting has shown that heavy regularization and ensembling continue to buy substantial data efficiency well past the point at which ordinary training overfits ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . PPT is motivated by the same scarcity, so these are competing answers to one question: what to do with compute once the natural-language data has run out. When data is instead plentiful, compute becomes the constraint, which is the setting where Hoffmann et al. (2022) show that model size and token count should be scaled together. Deployed models, however, are rarely trained at that ratio, because training compute is not the only cost; once inference is accounted for, this moves the optimum toward smaller models trained on more tokens ( Sardana et al., 2024 ; Touvron et al., 2023 ) . These are the three compute-matched regimes we study: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and over-Chinchilla, a comparison that prior PPT work has not explicitly made. Because the compute-optimal model size may itself depend on data quality and curriculum ( Bi et al., 2024 ) , in the data-constrained and data-unconstrained regimes we search model size separately for every method and budget.
blocks.zh: 如何使用计算的预算取决于哪些资源稀缺。 当自然语言是制约时,额外的计算购买只重复过同一种符号. Muennighoff等人(2023年)对此设定作了描述,发现对于他们的模型和数据来说,多达四个重复的时代接近于无所失失,之后额外计算的收益迅速减少,而新的数据更有用. 慢跑基准(Vegesna等,2026年)将政权以极端形式隔离出来,固定了100M-token的FineWeb样本并留下计算基本不受约束. 在这一背景下的工作表明,大量正规化和综艺活动继续取得相当高的数据效率,远远超过普通培训过度的程度(Kim等人,2025年)。 PPT的动机是相同的稀缺性,所以这些是对一个问题的相竞争的答案:自然语言数据耗尽后,该如何计算. 当数据充足时,计算就会成为制约,这就是霍夫曼等人(2022年)表明模型大小和令牌计数应当一起缩放的设定. 然而,部署的模型很少接受这种比例的培训,因为计算培训并不是唯一的费用;一旦计算出推论,这便将最佳模式推向接受更多标志性培训的较小模型(Sardana等,2024;Touvron等,2023)。 这些是我们研究的三种计算匹配的制度:数据受限,数据受限,和过量的Chinchilla,这种比较是先前PPT工作没有明确作出的. 由于计算-优化模型大小本身可能取决于数据质量和课程(Bi等,2024年),在数据受限和数据不受约束的制度中,我们为每一种方法和预算分别搜索模型大小.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: The research question we explore is: in additive and compute-matched settings, does PPT yield a measurable improvement over a natural-language baseline? We test this question in four settings, one in the additive setting, followed by three compute-matched configurations. In this section we describe the architecture, datasets, hyperparameter optimization, and evaluation protocol shared across all four settings.

The compute-matched experiments span three configurations. The data-constrained configuration fixes natural language at 100M tokens and the
total budget at 1 × 10 18 1\times 10^{18} FLOPs. The data-unconstrained configuration leaves natural language abundant and sweeps over 1 × 10 18 1\times 10^{18} , 3 × 10 18 3\times 10^{18} and 9 × 10 18 9\times 10^{18} FLOP budgets. At each budget, we search over model size to minimize validation loss so models are trained at compute-optimality. The over-Chinchilla configuration trains a model of 881M parameters on 50B tokens, ∼ 57 {\sim}57 tokens per parameter, evaluating NCA and k k -Dyck, the two curricula from prior work we revisit, each at 1% (500M tokens). In all three compute-matched settings we use only the spectral-based default initialization of the NanoChat version we build on ( Karpathy, 2025 ) , as it has been well tuned by the NanoChat community. Using this initialization is further supported by our additive compute experiments, where at the largest natural-language budget the spectral-based initialization performed best for both the baseline and the PPT methods (Figure 4 ).

All our models are trained using a fork of NanoChat, with the Muon optimizer ( Jordan et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Karpathy, 2025 ) , which updates the transformer blocks’ weight matrices, while the embedding and unembedding tables are trained under AdamW.
However, we find that in our smaller-scale experiments the PPT phase often does better under AdamW, while at larger scales Muon performs on par, and so we ablate AdamW, applied to all parameters, only for the additive-compute experiments and the 1 × 10 18 1{\times}10^{18} data-constrained experiment. NanoChat sets the hidden size to 64 ​ d 64d for a model of depth d d , so the parameter count follows from the depth alone. Depth is therefore the only capacity-related hyperparameter we search.

然而,我们发现,在我们规模较小的实验中,PPT阶段往往在AdamW下表现得更好,而在更大的尺度上,Muon表现得更好,因此我们把AdamW降级,应用到所有参数上,只用于添加剂计算实验和1×10 18 1\1\x18}10\x18}数据约束实验. 纳诺 聊天将隐藏大小设置为64 d 64d,作为深度d d 的模型,因此参数计数仅从深度开始. 因此,深度是我们唯一一个与容量有关的超参数。

blocks.en: For our main natural-language corpus we follow NanoChat and use FineWeb ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) . For k k -Dyck and NCA, we generate the data using the same code released by prior work (Appendices A.1 and A.2 ). We additionally introduce DeclRef, a synthetic corpus that, like the procedural tasks of Jiang et al. (2026) , targets retrieval from context (Appendix A.3 ). Examples of these PPT distributions can be seen in Figure 2 . Alongside the synthetic curricula, we pre-pretrain on two real-text corpora, C4 ( Raffel et al., 2023 ) as a natural-language control and the GitHub Code dataset ( CodeParrot, 2022 ) . The additive setting is aimed at revisiting the additive-compute claims made for the synthetic distributions of prior work, NCA and k k -Dyck, so for this setting we do not test DeclRef. Our data-constrained experiments add DeclRef but leave out code and C4, since these supply additional real text, which would break the 100M-token constraint on natural language. The data-unconstrained experiments do include these other corpora, while the over-Chinchilla experiments return to NCA and k k -Dyck alone. Following prior work ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , the synthetic languages are encoded with their own, far smaller vocabularies. At the phase boundary we therefore expand the vocabulary to its natural-language size and reinitialize both the token embedding table and the language-modeling head, carrying only the transformer body across; each phase has its own learning-rate schedule and the optimizer state is reset at the boundary. Code and C4 share the natural-language tokenizer, so their embedding table and head carry over unchanged. The C4 control instead runs both its PPT and PT phases under a single learning-rate schedule with no optimizer state reset, since in our experiments resetting the optimizer state at the boundary hurt its final loss (Appendix D.3 ). This deviates from prior implementations, which run the natural-language control as a separate phase with its own learning-rate schedule and an optimizer state reset ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Yamaguchi et al., 2026 ) . We recommend this setup for natural-language controls in future PPT work.

C4控制则在单一学习率时间表下运行其PPT和PT两个阶段,没有优化状态重置,因为在我们的实验中,在边界重置优化状态会伤害其最终损失(附录D.3). 这偏离了以前的执行,将自然语言控制作为一个单独的阶段进行,有自己的学习率表和优化状态重置(Hu等,2025;Lee等,2026;山口等,2026). 我们建议在将来的PPT工作中为自然语言控制设置这个设置.

We additionally evaluate on held-out splits of C4 and GitHub code (Appendix E ), on the DCLM CORE suite ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and on BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) , the grammaticality benchmark used by Hu et al. blocks.en: PPT helps at small natural-language budgets, but not at larger ones. We next ask whether PPT can help in the additive setting, where the natural-language budget is tightly constrained and the synthetic phase does not compete for it. Figure 4 shows, for each PPT method at each natural-language token budget, the best PPT token count and weight initialization. At 50M and 100M natural-language tokens both PPT methods improve over the best no-PPT baseline, whose winning configuration uses spectral-based initialization. This means that at these low budgets the synthetic languages do instill useful inductive biases. This is also seen in Table 1 , where k k -Dyck PPT at the 50M natural-language token budget improves DCLM CORE accuracy over the no-PPT baseline. However, at 1B tokens, under the spectral-based initialization, all PPT methods fall within the baseline’s seed spread. Yet under the alternative baseline initialization, both PPT curricula still appear to improve over the baseline at the 1B token scale. The additive setting therefore shows two overlaid effects: at small natural-language budgets, PPT helps regardless of initialization, whereas at 1B it only helps against baselines without spectral-based initialization. For further details on these additive-compute experiments, see Appendix E.1 , where Figure 8 breaks the results down by initialization and PPT optimizer.
blocks.zh: PPT帮助提供少量的自然语言预算,但不能提供较大的预算。 我们接下来问PPT是否能够帮助添加剂设置,其中自然语言预算受到严格限制,合成相不相竞争. 图4显示,每个自然语言符号预算的每一种PPT方法,最优的PPT符号计数和权重初始化. 在50M和100M自然语言符号时,两种PPT方法都比最佳的无PPT基线有所改进,其取胜配置采用光谱基初始化. 这意味着,在这些低预算的情况下,合成语言确实产生了有益的诱导偏差。 表1也反映了这一点,在表1中,在50M自然语言符号预算中的k k-Dyck PPT提高了DCLM CORE的精确度,超过了无PPT基线. 然而,在以光谱为基础的初始化下,所有PPT方法都属于基线种子传播范围。 然而,在备选基准初始化下,两个PPT课程似乎仍比1B符号尺度的基准有所改进。 因此,添加剂设置显示出两种外加效应:在小型自然语言预算中,无论初始化与否,PPT都会有所帮助,而在1B时,它只有助于对照基线而无需光谱初始化。 关于这些添加剂计算实验的进一步详情,见附录E.1,图8通过初始化和PPT优化来分解结果.

blocks.en: 5 Compute-Matched
blocks.zh: 5 已计算

blocks.en: Although the previous section shows that PPT can improve performance when compute is added on top of a fixed natural-language budget, this does not establish that synthetic data is the best use of those resources. In practice, the same compute could instead be spent on further natural-language training, including repeated epochs when unique language is scarce. We therefore turn to compute-matched experiments, asking whether PPT can justify diverting part of the training budget away from natural language.
blocks.zh: 虽然上一节显示PPT在固定自然语言预算外加计算时可以提高性能,但这并不能确定合成数据是这些资源的最佳利用. 在实践中,同样的计算可以用于进一步的自然语言培训,包括当独特的语言稀缺时重复的时代。 因此,我们转而进行计算匹配的实验,问PPT是否能够证明将部分培训预算从自然语言中挪走是合理的。

blocks.en: Across the tested regimes, allocating compute to synthetic PPT never beats spending it on natural language. Figure 1 shows results across the three compute-matched configurations. In the data-constrained regime, diverting any fraction of the budget to synthetic PPT increases validation BPB, with the effect leveling off beyond 5%. The compute is better spent on additional epochs over the same natural-language data. In the over-Chinchilla regime, neither NCA nor k k -Dyck improves over the baseline on validation loss or DCLM CORE accuracy. The data-unconstrained scaling confirms this pattern holds across budgets: no PPT method significantly outperforms the baseline in terms of natural-language validation BPB, with 1% closer to the baseline than 5% at the two smaller budgets, and the natural-language C4 control matching the baseline. To check this trend, we fit a power law to each method’s results across these budgets and find that no PPT method has either a lower multiplicative constant or a significantly larger scaling exponent than the baseline (Appendix E.2 , Figure 9 ). We therefore find no evidence that these recipes scale better than the baseline. The BPB results are broadly reflected in the downstream DCLM CORE and BLiMP benchmarks, with the exceptions shown in Table 1 . At the lowest compute budget we study, DeclRef and code show some improvement over the baseline. However, how significant these gains are remains unclear. PPT on C4, the natural-language control, scores similarly to these synthetic PPT methods on DCLM CORE. In addition, these are the only experiments in which we observe an aggregate significant gain; every other method performs at or below the baseline (see Appendix E ). However, when breaking the two benchmarks into their individual tasks, we find that some PPT methods do improve on specific sub-tasks, but often at the cost of others, which is why most perform on par on aggregate (Appendix E.5 , Figure 11 ). This is especially the case for BLiMP, where some phenomena improve under PPT, in line with the BLiMP gains Hu et al. (2025) report for k k -Dyck.
blocks.zh: 在整个被测试的体系中,分配计算到合成的PPT中,从未比在自然语言上花得更好. 图1显示三个计算匹配配置的结果。 在数据受限的制度中,将预算的任何部分转用于合成PPT会增加验证BPB,效果会平息到5%以上. 计算最好用在同一个自然语言数据之上的额外纪元上. 在超Chinchilla制度下,NCAA和k-Dyck都没有改进关于验证损失或DCLM CORE准确性的基线。 数据不受限制的缩放证实了这种跨预算的模式:在自然语言验证方面,没有一种PPT方法明显地超过基线,在两个较小的预算方面比基线接近1%,而自然语言的C4控制与基线相匹配。 为了遏制这一趋势,我们对这些预算的每一种方法的结果都适用了权力法,并发现没有一种PPT方法具有比基线低得多的乘法常数或比基线大得多的缩放指数(附录E.2,图9)。 因此,我们没有发现任何证据表明这些办法比基线规模更好。 除表1所示的例外情况外,下游DCLM CORE和BLIMP基准大致反映了BPB结果。 在最低的计算预算中,我们研究了DeclRef和代码,显示比基线有所改进。 然而,这些成果有多大意义仍然不清楚。 在C4上的PPT,即自然语言控制,在DCLM CORE上得分与这些合成的PPT方法相似. 此外,这是我们观测到累积重大收益的唯一实验;所有其他方法都在基线或基准以下进行(见附录E)。 然而,当将两个基准突破到各自的任务中时,我们发现一些PPT方法确实在具体的子任务上有所改进,但往往会牺牲其他子任务,这就是为什么大多数子任务都是按等值的总和完成(附录E.5,图11)。 BLIMP尤其如此,根据BLIMP增益Hu等人,在PPT下,一些现象有所改善. blocks.en: We also observe no consistent ranking among PPT methods across configurations or scales. For example, DeclRef is marginally better than NCA and k k -Dyck in the data-constrained regime, but in the data-unconstrained regime the ordering varies with both the PPT percentage and the total compute budget. This is accentuated in the over-Chinchilla regime: with large token budgets and parameter counts, final validation loss between the baseline and PPT methods becomes very similar.
blocks.zh: 我们还观察到,不同配置或尺度的PPT方法之间没有一致的排名。 例如,DeclRef在数据约束制度中略好于NCAA和k-Dyck,但在数据约束的制度中,订单随PPT百分比和总计算预算而异。 这一点在过量的Chinchilla制度中更为突出:有了大量的符号预算和参数计数,基线与PPT方法之间的最终验证损失变得非常相近.

blocks.en: One reason PPT may fail to improve over the baseline is that what it learns does not carry over into PT. The shift from PPT to PT is abrupt: the PPT data differs substantially from natural language, and is seen only at the start of training and never again. Ibrahim et al. (2024) show that even a shift between two natural languages causes forgetting. Their work shows that continued pretraining on German, after 300B tokens of English, causes forgetting on the original English distribution. The shift from a synthetic distribution to natural language is even larger.
blocks.zh: PPT在基线上可能无法改进的一个原因是它所学到的东西不会传入PT. 从PPT到PT的转变是出乎意料的:PPT数据与自然语言差别很大,只有在培训开始时才能看到,而且再也不会看到. Ibrahim等人(2024年)表明,即使两种自然语言之间的转变也会导致遗忘. 他们的作品显示,继续德语预训,经过300B个英语符号后,导致对英语原版发行的遗忘. 从合成分布到自然语言的转变甚至更大.

blocks.en: We test this hypothesis by tracking the validation BPB of the NCA, k k -Dyck and code PPT distributions across the phase boundary, at 2.7 × 10 19 2.7\times 10^{19} FLOPs, a larger budget than the ones run in previous sections. This gives us a longer horizon over which to observe performance on the PPT distribution. The three right-hand panels in Figure 5 show the result: during the PPT phase all three methods learn their respective distributions, but at the PPT-to-PT boundary the BPB immediately starts increasing, signaling that the models forget their ability on the PPT distribution. The same figure suggests that this stems from front-loading the data in the PPT phase. Holding 5% of every batch as PPT data throughout training instead improves performance on the PPT distribution over the entire run. This is despite both schedules spending the same total compute on the PPT distribution. Forgetting at the boundary is therefore preventable by simply mixing in the synthetic distribution throughout PT. Interleaving improves FineWeb BPB for the PPT methods, though not significantly for all, and as these runs are not hyperparameter-tuned at this scale, how large the gain could be remains open.
blocks.zh: 我们通过跟踪NCAA的验证BPB,k-Dyck和代码PPT的跨相边界分布来测试这个假说,在 2.7 × 10 19 2.7\times 10^{19}FLOPs,这个预算比前几节运行的预算要大. 这给了我们一个更长的视野来观察 PPT 分发的性能. 图5中三个右侧面板显示结果:在PPT阶段,所有三种方法都学习各自的分布,但在PPT到-PT边界上,BPB立即开始增加,表示模型在PPT分布上忘记了它们的能力. 同一数字表明,这源于在PPT相中前置数据. 在整个培训期间,将每批5%的PPT数据作为PPT数据保存,从而改进了PPT在整个运行期间的分发情况。 尽管这两个时间表在PPT分配上的总计算相同,但情况并非如此。 因此,在边界上忘却是可避免的,只需将合成分布混入整个PT. 互通改进了PPT方法的FineWeb BPB,虽然对所有人来说并不显著,而且由于这些跑道没有在这个尺度上进行超参数调节,因此收益可以保持多高.

blocks.en: The differences we report between PPT and the baseline are small, and in some settings smaller than those previously reported. One reason is that we use NanoChat, which uses a different tokenizer, model architecture, and natural-language dataset than prior work. The tokenizer alone has been shown to change the effect of PPT ( Riazhskykh et al., 2026 ) . However, within our own experiments, the setup is held fixed across the baseline and the PPT methods, so any difference between them is attributable to PPT rather than to these details. Another reason for discrepancies with prior gains is the metric we report. In order to make our results easily comparable for future work, we evaluate using validation BPB. Prior work often reports results in perplexity, which is the exponential of the loss and hence yields larger relative differences than BPB. Hence, our BPB differences are not directly comparable to the perplexity ones shown in prior work.
blocks.zh: 我们报告的PPT与基线之间的差别很小,在某些环境下比以前报告的要小. 其中一个原因是我们使用"NanoChat",它使用与前作不同的活字化器,模型架构,以及自然语言数据集. 单是标注剂就被证明可以改变PPT的效果(Riazhskykh等,2026.). 然而,在我们自己的实验中,这种设置被固定在基线和PPT方法之间,因此它们之间的任何差异都归因于PPT而不是这些细节. 与以往成果有差异的另一个原因是我们报告的衡量标准。 为使我们的成果与今后的工作易于比较,我们利用BPB验证方法进行评估。 先前的工作往往造成困惑,这是损失的指数,因此产生的相对差异大于国际收支。 因此,我们的BPB差异不能直接与先前工作中的迷惑性差异相媲美。

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en: We set out to test whether PPT improves PT efficiency. Across three synthetic corpora and multiple training regimes, allocating compute to PPT never outperforms spending it on natural language. This holds even under a multi-epoch setting over 100M tokens. However, in the additive setting at the smallest natural-language budgets, a benefit persists even against a well-initialized baseline. Prior studies hold the initialization scheme fixed while varying the curriculum, a natural design choice for isolating the curriculum effect. Our results suggest that future robustness checks should additionally vary this axis for both PPT and no-PPT methods.
blocks.zh: 我们开始测试PPT是否提高了PT的效率. 三个人工合成体和多种训练系统 将计算结果分配到PPT中 绝对不会超过自然语言 即使在一个多纪元的时期下,它仍然有超过100兆个信使。 然而,在最小的自然语言预算的添加剂设置中,即使与一个良好的初始基准相比,这种效益仍然存在。 以前的研究规定,初始化计划必须固定,同时改变课程,这是孤立课程效果的自然设计选择。 我们的结果表明,今后对可靠性的检查应进一步改变PPT和无PPT方法的这一轴心。

blocks.en: Previous work argues that the priors learned during PPT persist through to the PT phase ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) . In our experiments, however, models do not retain their ability on the PPT distribution after the transition (Section 6 ). If such priors are indeed kept after PPT, we would expect the model to keep at least part of this ability. One could argue that losing this ability is expected, and that it may not matter how well the model does on the PPT distribution, as long as the priors survive. Once the PPT data is no longer present in training, the model no longer needs to assign probability to the PPT tokens, so it is likely that the performance on the PPT distribution degrades. However, if this were the sole reason for the drop in performance, degradation on the code distribution would not occur. Unlike the synthetic distributions, most tokens seen during the code PPT phase are also seen during the PT phase, since comments and variable names carry natural-language semantics. Hence, the model keeps learning to predict them during PT, albeit outside of code contexts. Yet, even in this case, loss on the code distribution rises after the phase boundary. This suggests that the priors learned on code-specific data are not fully kept, and are instead progressively overwritten once the distribution shifts abruptly to natural language. We therefore recommend that future work on synthetic data schedules also measure the model’s ability on the synthetic distribution throughout training, as a proxy for whether the inductive biases learned from it are retained.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作认为,PPT期间所学的学说一直持续到PT阶段(Hu等,2025;Lee等,2026)。 然而,在我们的实验中,模型在过渡后无法保留其在PPT分配方面的能力(第6节)。 如果此类前科确实保留在PPT之后,我们期望该模型至少能保留部分这种能力. 人们可以争辩说,预期会失去这种能力,而且只要前科能活下来,模型在PPT分发上的表现如何并不重要。 一旦PPT数据在培训中不再存在,模型就不再需要为PPT令牌指定概率,因此PPT分布上的性能很可能会降解. 然而,如果这是性能下降的唯一原因,则代码分配不会出现退化. 与合成分布不同,在代码PPT相相中所见到的大多数活字也出现在PT相中,因为评论和可变名都带有自然语言的语义. 因此,该模型不断学习在PT期间预测它们,尽管不在代码背景之外. 然而,即使在这种情况下,在相位边界之后,代码分配的损失也在增加。 这表明,在具体代码数据上学到的前科没有得到充分保存,而是在分发突然转向自然语言后逐步被覆盖。 因此,我们建议,今后关于合成数据时间表的工作也应衡量该模型在整个培训期间的合成分布能力,作为是否保留从中吸取的诱导性偏见的代名词。

blocks.en: A natural question is whether PPT could pay off at scales beyond those tested in this work. Though our largest models stay below one billion parameters, our over-Chinchilla experiments train an 881M-parameter model on 50B tokens, a compute budget comparable to or larger than experiments in prior PPT work ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Yamaguchi et al., 2026 ) . Even so, we show that neither NCA nor k k -Dyck improves on the baseline at this scale. We also approach the question from a scaling-law perspective, which motivates our data-unconstrained experiments. Such a perspective has not been explicitly analyzed in prior work. There, we search for each method’s compute-optimal recipe at three budgets and fit a power law to each, and find no evidence that any PPT method scales better than the baseline (Section 5 , Appendix E.2 ). Taken together, these results suggest that these PPT recipes would not overtake natural-language training at larger scales.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题就是,PPT能否以超出本作所测试的尺度获得回报. 虽然我们最大的模型仍低于10亿个参数,但我们的Chinchilla实验在50B令牌上训练出一个881M参数模型,这个计算预算与先前PPT工作中的实验相当或更大(Hu等,2025;Lee等,2026;山口等,2026)。 即使如此,我们表明NCAA和k-k-Dyck在这个尺度上都没有改进基线. 我们还从规模法的角度来处理这个问题,这促使我们进行不受数据限制的实验。 在以前的工作中没有明确分析这种观点。 在那里,我们从三个预算中寻找每种方法的计算-最佳方法,并采用每种方法的权力法,没有发现任何证据表明任何PPT方法比基线(第5节,附录E.2 ) 更好。 总之,这些结果表明,这些PPT配方不会超过更广泛的自然语言培训。

blocks.en: Next, our main conclusions concern natural-language validation loss. On downstream benchmarks, where prior work highlights gains ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Yamaguchi et al., 2026 ) , for example on specific BLiMP phenomena ( Hu et al., 2025 ) and on reasoning benchmarks after fine-tuning ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , the picture is less clear. In our experiments, aggregate BLiMP and DCLM CORE scores mostly match the baseline. However, exceptions exist on individual sub-tasks, including BLiMP phenomena, which shift in both directions, though without a clear pattern across methods or settings (Figure 11 ). Hence, PPT may still shape narrower capabilities that aggregate benchmarks do not capture, which more targeted evaluations could bring out. Where it does, integrating synthetic data gradually rather than front-loading it could help better retain these capabilities. PPT could similarly prove more useful in other data modalities, which our study, limited to language modeling, does not examine.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们的主要结论涉及自然语言验证损失。 在下游基准上,先前的工作突出收益(Hu等,2025;Lee等,2026;Yamaguchi等,2026),例如具体BLIMP现象(Hu等,2025)和微调后推理基准(Lee等,2026),情况不太清楚. 在我们的实验中,综合BLIMP和DCLMCORE的得分大多与基准一致. 然而,个别子任务存在例外,包括BLIMP现象,它们双向转移,虽然没有在方法或设置之间有明确的模式(图11.). 因此,预防酷刑方案仍可能形成较窄的能力,而综合基准无法捕捉到,而更有针对性的评价可以带来这种能力。 在它这样做的地方,将合成数据逐步整合,而不是前置,有助于更好地保留这些能力。 PPT同样可以证明在其他数据模式中更有用,我们的研究仅限于语言建模,没有加以研究.

blocks.en: Moreover, our findings leave open questions for future work. As natural-language data is increasingly constrained relative to available compute ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , synthetic data is a compelling prospect. That said, our results motivate rethinking whether such data should be integrated via an explicit PPT phase. For such a phase to be worthwhile, the forgetting across the phase boundary must first be solved. Alternatively, this forgetting can be avoided by interleaving synthetic data throughout training. We therefore recommend that future work investigate better interleaving schedules. However, whether such schedules make synthetic data a better use of compute than natural language remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的调查结果给今后的工作留下了未决问题。 由于自然语言数据相对于现有计算数据(Kim等人,2025年)越来越受限制,合成数据是一个令人信服的前景。 尽管如此,我们的成果促使人们重新思考是否应通过一个明确的预防、预防和预防阶段来整合这些数据。 为了使这一阶段变得值得,必须首先解决跨阶段边界的遗忘问题。 或者,通过在整个培训过程中将合成数据相交,可以避免这种遗忘。 因此,我们建议今后的工作更好地调查离职时间表。 然而,这些时间表是否使合成数据比自然语言更能使用计算,仍然是一个未决问题。

We choose these parameters with the following goal in mind: that predicting a token
should mainly require using the current document rather than memorizing. Name and Value tokens are drawn partly from a fixed table of likely successors shared by every document, as in natural language, where some word sequences are common across all text, and partly at random. The shared part can be learned across documents, while the random part cannot. The random part aims to provide the corpus with entropy. A Value is therefore only partly predictable when it is declared, so a reference must mainly retrieve it from the current document. The Zipf token frequencies are also redrawn for every document, so they must be inferred from the current one. Which Names can be referenced at all depends on the Scopes currently open, so both the answer and the space of possible answers are properties of the local context. The parameter values are provided in the generator code released with this paper.

blocks.en: Appendix C FLOP Measurement

blocks.en:
To convert a FLOP budget into a training configuration, we measure the FLOPs of
one forward and backward pass (one optimization step) for the model using the
FLOP-counting utilities in PyTorch ( PyTorch, 2026c ) . We then divide the
total budget by the FLOPs per step to determine the number of optimization steps
and tokens consumed by each phase. Working backwards from a FLOP budget to a configuration is the
standard framing of compute-optimal PT ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) ,
and it is what allows a PPT method and its baseline to be compared on
equal terms for the compute-matched experiments. We measure FLOPs directly rather than matching token counts for compute matching because the synthetic corpora use much smaller vocabularies than natural language, so the language-modeling head, and with it the FLOPs per token, is smaller during PPT. Given its smaller vocabulary size, the PPT phase is therefore afforded extra steps. However, this difference shrinks as models grow, since the language-modeling head makes up a decreasing share of the total parameters. For the over-Chinchilla configuration, our largest model, we therefore simply allocate tokens directly, 0.5B to PPT and 49.5B to FineWeb against the baseline’s 50B, so that every method sees the same total number of tokens (Appendix D.6 ).

blocks.en: D.1 How LLMTuna works
blocks.zh: D.1 LLMTuna如何运作

blocks.en: LLMTuna is a language-model-based hyperparameter optimizer that we release with this work. The approach is inspired by prior work that also used language models for hyperparameter optimization and autoresearch more broadly ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Jiang & Zhao, 2026 ; Karpathy, 2026a ) . LLMTuna maintains an ordered history of configurations tried so far and their corresponding scores, which in our experiments are validation BPB. At each step, a language model uses this history together with any additional context provided, such as training code, notes on hyperparameter behavior, or constraints on the search, to propose the next configuration. This gives the model semantic context from the codebase that can inform which hyperparameters are likely to matter. The search space is specified using three parameter types, Float , Int , and Choice , each with a name, a natural-language description, and optional bounds and initial value.
blocks.zh: LLMTuna是一个基于语言模型的超参数优化器,我们随此作品而发布. 这个方法受到前作的启发,前作中也使用了语言模型来进行更广义的超参数优化和自发研究(Yang等,2024a;Jiang & Zhao,2026;Karpathy,2026a.). LLMTuna保持了迄今为止所尝试的配置及其相应分数的有序历史,这在我们实验中是验证BPB. 在每一步,一个语言模型都会使用这个历史以及所提供的任何附加上下文,比如训练代码,超参数行为说明,或者搜索的限制,来提出下一个配置. 这使得模型语义上下文从代码库中可以得知哪些超参数可能很重要. 搜索空间使用三个参数类型来指定 Float, Int, and Choice ,每个参数类型都有名称,自然语言描述,以及可选的边框和初始值.

blocks.en: Following the API design of Optuna ( Akiba et al., 2019 ) , the optimization loop consists of two calls. suggest provides the accumulated context to the model together with a tool whose schema is generated from the search space, so the proposal is returned as JSON in a fixed shape rather than as prose. observe then records the configuration and its resulting score, adding the trial to the history available to subsequent calls to suggest .
